text.title: API Versioning Worked Examples
text.summary: Two end-to-end worked examples applying the methodology to representative inputs — a removed field and a newly-required field. Output matches the schema in content/02-output-contract.xml.

section.title: Trace
section.paragraph: openapi diff shows 1 BREAKING (removed field email_verified) → decision=vN+1 → copy /api/v1/users handler to /api/v2/users with the field removed → mark v1 route deprecated in ops/sunset.yaml → measure traffic → 410 Gone on sunset date → delete handler after 30d zero traffic.

section.title: Resulting artefact
section.code: { "spec_id": "openapi.yaml", "decision": "create_v_next", "from_version": "v1", "to_version": "v2", "deprecation_date": "2026-06-01", "sunset_date": "2026-12-01", "rationale": "Removed email_verified field; breaking diff ids: response-property-removed.", "breaking_diff_ids": [ "response-property-removed" ] }

section.title: Second example — optional field becomes required
section.paragraph: POST /charges gains a required `amount` field on a public API already versioned url-path. The classifier branch optional_field_became_required fires, so change_kind=breaking even though nothing was removed — this is the case teams most often ship as additive. Window sized at 180 days for a public audience; sunset_date = today + 180.

section.title: Second example — resulting artefact
section.code: { "spec_id": "openapi.yaml", "decision": "create_v_next", "scheme": "url-path", "from_version": "v1", "to_version": "v2", "deprecation_date": "2026-05-27", "sunset_date": "2026-11-23", "deprecation_window_days": 180, "rationale": "Field 'amount' became required on POST /charges; 422 replaced 400 for semantic validation.", "breaking_diff_ids": [ "request-property-became-required", "response-status-removed" ] }

section.title: Decision path applied
section.paragraph: The decision tree in content/06-decision-tree.xml routed both inputs to the recommended action: the breaking/additive classifier produced change_kind, the scheme classifier confirmed url-path, and the deprecation-window gate passed the window. Each rule referenced by the conclusions is listed in content/01-core-rules.xml.
